description.en:
Sets the horizontal and vertical scale of a named caption (created with one of the CMND_2DO_CREATE_*_TELOP functions).
The cutscene scripts use it to zoom the technique name in and out.
Name of the caption to scale.

null if the engine is not ready, fewer than 3 arguments were given, or no caption has that name.
On success the native reports a result without pushing one, so Squirrel hands back the last argument (scaleY).

examples.case: Zooming a caption uniformly (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut; caption names shortened from the script's Shift-JIS names)
